t: This is the Massey Shaw, a former London Fire Brigade fireboat, now moored in the West India Docks. She was built in 1935, decommissioned in 1971, and restored in the early twenty-first century. She's named after Captain Sir Eyre Massey Shaw, the first Chief Officer of the Metropolitan Fire Brigade. Shaw led the brigade's predecessor from 1861 to 1891, introduced modern firefighting methods and increased the number of stations. Before that he'd served in the army and as Chief Constable of Belfast Borough Police.
